name: Smt. Uma Gupta Fellowship for M.Sc. Agriculture (Genetics & Plant Breeding) Students
benefit: **Amount of Fellowship:** ₹1,000/- per month (For three semesters only).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the M.Sc. Agriculture (Genetics & Plant Breeding) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The fellowship is awarded for a duration of three semesters only.
